summary: Which colour is which series, for a chart drawn with visx. The swatch reads the same token as the series.
useWhen: a chart has more than one series
a single-series chart sits beside others and its colour needs naming

useInstead.when: the lines are few and there is room to label each at its end
useInstead.use: direct labels in the SVG, with the series class on the text

useInstead.when: the scale is a magnitude ramp (a heatmap), not categories

composition.note: Items are listed in the order the series are drawn, with the same series numbers the chart uses. Place it above or below the plot inside the same .ion-chart figure.
composition.example: <ChartLegend shape="line" items={[{ label: 'Production', series: 1 }, { label: 'Staging', series: 2 }]} />

square.use: the default — bars, areas and heatmap-like marks

line.use: line charts, so the key looks like the mark it names

guarantees: a list, so a screen reader announces how many series there are
swatches are aria-hidden; every series is named in text
requires: series numbers matching the chart — the legend cannot see the chart

antiPatterns.dont: a multi-series chart with no legend and no direct labels
antiPatterns.why: colour becomes the only way to tell series apart, which fails SC 1.4.1 and fails anyone who cannot tell blue from purple

antiPatterns.dont: listing series in a different order from the chart
antiPatterns.why: the reader matches legend to chart by position as much as by colour
